messages.subject: inla call is 'killed'
parts:
Hi,

Inla call is 'killed', not quite sure what might cause this behavior.

#formula
form <- y ~ 0 + zIntercept + yIntercept + 
f(iz, model=spde4) + 
f(iy, copy='iz', 
hyper=list(theta=list(fixed=FALSE,  param=c(-2,5),
initial=-2))) 

#stacking
stk<-inla.stack(tag='est', data=list(y=Y), A=list(rBind(A,a0),1, rBind(a0,A),1),
effects=list(ind.z,zIntercept=zIntrcpt,
    ind.y,yIntercept=1-zIntrcpt))


> res <- inla(formula=form, family=c('binomial', 'gaussian'), 
+     data=inla.stack.data(stk), 
+     control.predictor=list(A=inla.stack.A(stk),compute=TRUE),
+     control.compute=list(dic=TRUE))
